description: Returns the RoomExpert verdict for one hotel: overall score, the eight axis scores and what each is based on, how deep the coverage is, the loyalty program, and the award price where a real one exists. Answers "is this hotel any good" and "what is it strong at". Returns Markdown: a score table with one row per axis ("no evidence" where an axis has none), the award line, and the hotel page url. An unknown slug returns up to five near matches. The quotes behind the scores come from get_evidence.

slug.description: The hotel slug, e.g. "andaz-maui-at-wailea-resort". Lowercase, hyphenated.

name: get_hotel
title: Get hotel verdict
